856e40091f34.No authentication: No authentication lets anyone with the link chat and gives the agent no user identity, which is not appropriate for an internal HR agent.
856e40091f34.Authenticate manually with Generic OAuth: Generic OAuth 2 requires you to configure an identity provider manually, which the requirement explicitly wants to avoid.
856e40091f34.Authenticate manually with Microsoft Ent: Manual Entra ID V2 works but requires an app registration and manual settings, so it is not the zero-configuration choice.

d421b20d09e5.Authenticate with Microsoft: Authenticate with Microsoft provides User.ID and User.DisplayName but not an access token, and it targets Microsoft channels.
d421b20d09e5.No authentication: No authentication provides no user identity or token at all.
d421b20d09e5.Require users to sign in with Authentica: Require users to sign in is not configurable with Authenticate with Microsoft, and that option still would not expose an access token.

e8d57da9fdf2.Turn on Require users to sign in for eve: Changing each agent manually is not enforced centrally, and makers could switch the setting back.
e8d57da9fdf2.Remove the Environment Maker role from a: Removing Environment Maker stops makers from using Copilot Studio at all rather than enforcing authentication.
e8d57da9fdf2.Block the Direct Line channels connector: Blocking Direct Line channels restricts channels but does not by itself force authentication, and if no channel is allowed agents cannot be published at all.

f83b8d2a564b.A custom connector for each approved dom: Building custom connectors and blocking HTTP is far more work and is not how the requirement to limit HTTP destinations is met.
f83b8d2a564b.A Managed Environment IP firewall rule f: An IP firewall controls inbound access to Dataverse and does not restrict the URLs that the HTTP connector calls.
f83b8d2a564b.An Azure API Management policy in front: API Management can secure APIs you own but cannot stop makers from pointing HTTP requests at other domains.

8879cf57f58a.The policy only applies after every agen: Data policy enforcement is real time and does not wait for republishing.
8879cf57f58a.Data policies never apply to knowledge s: Data policies do govern knowledge sources, which is why the documents connector can be blocked in the first place.
8879cf57f58a.SharePoint knowledge is controlled only: Site permissions control what users can see, but data policies decide whether makers can add SharePoint knowledge at all.

868beb5bf171.End-user credentials, with the risk that: End-user credentials need a user to sign in, which is impossible for an unattended scheduled run.
End-user credentials still require an interactive user, so token expiry is not the deciding issue.
868beb5bf171.Maker-provided credentials, with the ris: Maker-provided credentials do not block sharing, and the real risk is privilege exposure rather than shareability.

c25a46dd6d3e.A connected agent for each team: A connected agent is a separate agent that is called at runtime, not a package of reusable topics and entities.
c25a46dd6d3e.A shared Dataverse table of topic defini: Storing topic definitions in a custom table is not a supported reuse mechanism in Copilot Studio.
c25a46dd6d3e.A copy of the agent per team: Copying the agent duplicates components and leaves each team maintaining its own diverging copy.

bf33c16fd22b.Share the agent with the security group,: With Generic OAuth 2, sharing cannot restrict specific users, so sharing alone does not enforce the group limit.
bf33c16fd22b.Turn on Require users to sign in while k: Even with sign-in turned on, Generic OAuth 2 does not let sharing restrict access to specific organization users.
bf33c16fd22b.Set the agent to No authentication and s: No authentication makes the agent available to anyone with the link, the opposite of the requirement.

f6fd309c713d.SharePoint knowledge is limited to four: Generative orchestration supports up to 25 SharePoint URLs, and the count is not the real problem here.
f6fd309c713d.SharePoint knowledge works only in class: SharePoint knowledge works with generative orchestration, so the orchestration mode is not the issue.
f6fd309c713d.SharePoint knowledge needs a Copilot con: SharePoint is a native knowledge source and does not need a Copilot connector.

5cfe2eeb1946.Teams caches agents for 24 hours, so the: There is no 24-hour reinstall requirement. Updates appear in a new session, or within about an hour in persistent channels.
5cfe2eeb1946.Publishing does not update Teams, so you: Publishing applies changes to all connected channels, including Teams.
5cfe2eeb1946.The user lacks the ChatBotReaders privil: A missing privilege would block chatting entirely rather than show stale content.

06e74068ec2e.Environment Maker: Environment Maker lets users build in the environment but does not grant transcript access.
06e74068ec2e.Agent Viewer: Agent Viewer gives access to the Evaluation page without access to the agent's content, not transcripts.
06e74068ec2e.System Customizer: System Customizer allows solution customization but is not the role designed for transcript review.

9f0759214592.Lowest disables citations for all answer: Moderation level does not control whether citations are produced.
9f0759214592.Lowest forces the agent to use only gene: Moderation level filters responses and does not change which knowledge sources are used.
9f0759214592.Lowest increases latency because more so: Moderation level does not change the number of sources searched, so latency is not the tradeoff.

d240d10560d9.When a HTTP request is received, and Res: The HTTP request trigger and Response action are for HTTP-invoked flows, not agent tools.
d240d10560d9.Manually trigger a flow, and Respond to: The PowerApp response action pairs with app or flow triggers and doesn't make the flow available as an agent tool.
d240d10560d9.Recurrence, and Send an email notificati: A recurrence trigger runs on a schedule and can't be called by the agent.

3faf024dc6cb.The flow is not in a solution, so it tim: Being in a solution adds versioning and ALM features but has nothing to do with the response limit.
3faf024dc6cb.Agent flows cannot query external system: Agent flows can use connectors to reach external systems.
3faf024dc6cb.The topic needs a Send HTTP request node: Replacing the flow with an HTTP node does not fix a slow back end, and the HTTP node also has a timeout.

c68ce16c5547.Asynchronous response is only supported: The requirement is about real-time response for tools, not about the orchestration mode.
c68ce16c5547.Asynchronous response requires a premium: Licensing is not the cause, and agent flows are billed against Copilot Studio capacity.
c68ce16c5547.Asynchronous response must be paired wit: A Recurrence trigger would stop the agent from calling the flow at all.

7889c286e66f.Run a multistage approval: A multistage approval returns approve or reject decisions, not structured data like an amount and a date.
7889c286e66f.Post adaptive card and wait for a respon: A Teams adaptive card can collect data, but the built-in human-in-the-loop action for agent flows is Request for information.
7889c286e66f.Send an email with options: Send an email with options captures a single choice and does not collect typed values like amounts and dates.

5683f2a52311.It waits until all three reviewers respo: The action doesn't wait for everyone. It resumes after the first submission.
5683f2a52311.It uses the most common answer among the: There is no voting or majority logic in Request for information.
5683f2a52311.It fails because answers conflict: Conflicting answers don't fail the flow because later responses are simply ignored.

63b9bd1eba13.Yes/No: Yes/No is one of the supported input types.
63b9bd1eba13.Date: Date is one of the supported input types.
63b9bd1eba13.Email: Email is one of the supported input types.

cf3751db7382.A prompt action followed by a Condition: A prompt plus email can be built but lacks the tracked approval stages and history that multistage approvals provide.
cf3751db7382.Two Request for information actions in s: Request for information collects data and doesn't produce approval decisions.
cf3751db7382.A connected agent that screens requests: A connected agent doesn't provide a human sign-off stage or approval history.

40ba423e7a49.The manager approves once and both stage: A single approval does not satisfy two stages. The documented behavior is a failure.
40ba423e7a49.Stage 3 is skipped automatically: There is no automatic stage skipping for duplicate approvers.
40ba423e7a49.The approval converts to Everyone must a: The approval type is set per manual stage and doesn't change because of duplicate approvers.

6022c7349dbf.Each run requires a Power Automate Premi: Agent flows don't use Power Automate per-user licensing.
6022c7349dbf.Agent flows are free and have no capacit: Agent flow actions consume capacity, except in cases such as test runs.
6022c7349dbf.Each run consumes Power Automate API req: Billing is against Copilot Studio capacity rather than Power Automate request limits.

75aff5c8186c.Each test run consumes double capacity: There is no double charge for tests. They are not billed for agent flow actions.
75aff5c8186c.Test runs consume capacity only for prem: Connector tier doesn't change the fact that test runs are excluded.
75aff5c8186c.Test runs are blocked until capacity is: Test runs are not blocked and don't need purchased capacity.

573b666b81c8.Turn on Asynchronous response so errors: Asynchronous response stops the flow from working as a tool, and it doesn't handle errors.
573b666b81c8.Add a Recurrence trigger that retries ev: A recurrence trigger would prevent the agent from calling the flow.
573b666b81c8.Remove the Respond to the agent action s: Without Respond to the agent the flow can't be used as a tool or return a result.

8848b17e3031.Running the flow from a scheduled trigge: A scheduled trigger would stop the agent from calling the flow on demand.
8848b17e3031.Setting the flow owner to a service acco: Flow ownership doesn't help the orchestrator understand when or how to call it.
8848b17e3031.Storing the order number in a Dataverse: Pre-storing the value isn't needed. The agent can pass it as an input parameter.

451f9ee66292.Add it as an agent-level tool with a det: An agent-level tool can be chosen by the orchestrator at runtime, which is what you want to avoid.
451f9ee66292.Add it as a connected agent: A flow isn't added as a connected agent, which is a separate agent.
451f9ee66292.Add it to a component collection: Component collections package components for reuse and don't control when the flow runs.

22bd02f04f7c.Raise an error, and then edit the On Err: Raise an error is the default, and it stops the topic and triggers On Error.
22bd02f04f7c.A Request timeout of 0 milliseconds: Changing the timeout doesn't handle HTTP error responses.
22bd02f04f7c.A Parse value node before the HTTP node: Parse value converts data but can't run before a response exists.

4e70553ce8c8.The variable is a String, so wrap it in: The type is Any, not String, and Text() wouldn't expose record fields.
4e70553ce8c8.The variable is global, so change its sc: Scope doesn't affect whether you can read fields of the value.
4e70553ce8c8.The variable is empty until the On Error: With Continue on error the variable is filled immediately, and On Error isn't triggered.

eaeb5e07ab07.The Response data type, which defaults t: The response data type doesn't cause requests to fail because of duration.
eaeb5e07ab07.The reprompt count, which defaults to tw: Reprompts apply to questions and adaptive cards, not HTTP calls.
eaeb5e07ab07.The content moderation level, which defa: Content moderation applies to generative answers, not HTTP calls.

831f6bf4a0e7.The node falls back to agent-level knowl: There is no fallback to agent-level sources when the node is restricted to selected sources.
831f6bf4a0e7.The node searches all public websites in: The node doesn't automatically add web search when the selected source has no answer.
831f6bf4a0e7.The node routes the question to a connec: The node doesn't route to other agents. That would be an orchestration decision.

12215f66565f.Keep Send a message on, and Teams wraps: With Send a message on, the answer is sent immediately as-is and you can't wrap it in a custom card.
12215f66565f.Use a Send HTTP request node to post the: Posting to Teams through HTTP bypasses the conversation and isn't how you customize answers.
12215f66565f.Set content moderation to Highest to ena: Moderation level filters content and has nothing to do with rendering cards.

13ab97a26220.Add the text as a public website source: A variable's content isn't a public website, so it can't be added as one.
13ab97a26220.Turn on web search and general knowledge: Turning on web search and general knowledge violates the requirement to answer only from the text.
13ab97a26220.Upload the text as a file to agent-level: Uploading a static file doesn't use the dynamic value retrieved at runtime.

970ab6d22f52.A Message node with a basic card: Message node cards are non-interactive and don't collect inputs into variables.
970ab6d22f52.Three Question nodes with entity extract: Three Question nodes would work but use three turns, not one form step.
970ab6d22f52.A Message node with quick replies: Quick replies are suggestion buttons and can't collect multiple typed fields.

38af5c8ba8fd.Insert {Topic.CustomerName} into the car: Plain JSON in the card editor isn't evaluated as Power Fx, so this doesn't bind variables.
38af5c8ba8fd.Use a Parse value node to inject variabl: Parse value converts data into records and doesn't populate card templates.
38af5c8ba8fd.Change the card version to 1.6 so variab: The schema version doesn't enable variable binding.

2746dc484d31.Teams doesn't support Action.Submit: Teams supports Action.Submit. The problem is the schema version.
2746dc484d31.Teams requires the card to be sent from: Adaptive Card nodes work in Teams, so a Message node isn't required.
2746dc484d31.Teams cards must be authored in Power Fx: JSON and Power Fx authoring both produce the same card, so authoring style isn't the cause.

77478eb498a1.Return values to original topics: Return values to original topics sends values back to the caller, not into the called topic.
77478eb498a1.External sources can set values: External sources can set values is for values passed in from outside the agent, such as a web page.
77478eb498a1.Global (any topic can access): Making the variable global would work differently and isn't the designed way to pass inputs between topics.

a25e49037a78.A topic variable configured with Receive: Receive values from other topics only accepts values from redirecting topics.
a25e49037a78.An environment variable of type Text: Environment variables are set by admins per environment, not per conversation.
a25e49037a78.A system variable named Conversation.Tie: You can't create custom system variables, which are built in.

3b30ba85870f.Global.Region: The prefix isn't included when the variable is set externally.
3b30ba85870f.Env.Region: Env. is for environment variables, which can't be set from the page.
3b30ba85870f.System.Region: System. is for built-in system variables, not custom ones.

ba2f5d37b839.Environment variables can only be change: Environment variables are read-only in Copilot Studio and are changed in Power Apps.
ba2f5d37b839.Environment variables update in the agen: Exporting a solution doesn't refresh the published agent.
ba2f5d37b839.Environment variables of type Text are c: There is no 24-hour cache. Republishing is what applies the change.

727eb6ce72ce.Prompts can't be used inside topics: Prompts can be added as nodes in topics.
727eb6ce72ce.Anonymous agents can use prompts in topi: Anonymous agents can still select models. The limit is Dataverse knowledge.
727eb6ce72ce.The prompt must be converted to an agent: A prompt can be used directly in a topic without an agent flow.

2261d2f249cd.Add the Sites.Read.All scope: Sites.Read.All is for SharePoint sites, not external items indexed by Copilot connectors.
2261d2f249cd.Turn on Official source for the connecto: Official source changes how answers are presented and doesn't grant access.
2261d2f249cd.Switch the agent to No authentication: Copilot connector knowledge requires user authentication, so No authentication won't work.

723252546c71.Copilot connectors cache answers per ses: Session caching doesn't explain consistent differences between users.
723252546c71.Copilot connectors index only the first: Indexing isn't tied to the first user. Access is trimmed per user.

6aa818173fd7.All records are copied into Dataverse ni: Records aren't copied into Dataverse. There's no data movement between systems.
6aa818173fd7.Records are copied into a vector index i: No vector index of records is created for real-time connector knowledge.
6aa818173fd7.Data is cached for 24 hours in the agent: Queries run at runtime and there is no 24-hour data cache.

0fc7b7791992.Add all three indexes to one Azure AI Se: A single knowledge source supports only one vector index.
0fc7b7791992.Merge the indexes into a skillset: Skillsets enrich content during indexing and don't merge indexes for querying.
0fc7b7791992.Use a Send HTTP request node for each in: HTTP calls bypass the knowledge integration and its citations.

b96b4b0caa2d.Write an Azure Function that embeds each: A custom function is unnecessary when integrated vectorization is used.
b96b4b0caa2d.Export the embeddings to Dataverse: Embeddings don't need to be in Dataverse for Azure AI Search knowledge.
b96b4b0caa2d.Add a prompt tool that generates embeddi: Prompts don't generate embeddings for search queries.

4d6fdf1cdcaa.chunk_id: chunk_id identifies a chunk, not a document location.
4d6fdf1cdcaa.@search.score: The search score is a relevance value, not a citation.
4d6fdf1cdcaa.content_vector: The vector field holds embeddings and can't be shown as a citation.

8fb3c437ee6e.A public IP rule allowing Copilot Studio: Opening a public IP rule defeats the purpose of a private endpoint.
8fb3c437ee6e.A Copilot connector for the search servi: Copilot connectors index content into Microsoft Graph and aren't how you reach a private search service.
8fb3c437ee6e.A Send HTTP request node that calls the: Embedding an admin key in an HTTP node is insecure and doesn't solve private network access.

a5aeec962a51.It searches all 40 sources for every que: Above the threshold the agent doesn't search everything. It filters sources first.
a5aeec962a51.It fails to publish because the limit is: The agent still publishes. The threshold changes how sources are selected.
a5aeec962a51.It searches only the first 25 sources, i: Sources aren't selected by list order.

620bff577554.Official source works only for public we: The setting isn't limited to public websites.
620bff577554.Official source requires Azure AI Search: Official source doesn't depend on Azure AI Search.
620bff577554.Official source requires No authenticati: Authentication isn't the conflict. Orchestration mode is.

3bb51dbde457.Add it at agent level on the Knowledge p: Bing Custom Search isn't supported as an agent-level knowledge source.
3bb51dbde457.Add it as a connected agent: It isn't an agent and can't be connected as one.
3bb51dbde457.Add it as an MCP server: Bing Custom Search isn't exposed as an MCP server in Copilot Studio.

548a0a9accbf.Agent-level sources always take priority: Agent-level sources are the fallback, not the priority.
548a0a9accbf.Both are merged and ranked by date: Results aren't merged and ranked by date.
548a0a9accbf.The source added most recently: Priority doesn't depend on when the source was added.

2d7d66d5ad37.A REST API tool: A REST API tool requires an API and OpenAPI definition, which the portal lacks.
2d7d66d5ad37.An MCP server tool: An MCP tool also requires a server exposing operations, which doesn't exist here.
2d7d66d5ad37.A Copilot connector: Copilot connectors index content for knowledge and don't perform UI actions.

9dfb00fa7370.Official source: Official source is a knowledge setting and is unrelated.
9dfb00fa7370.Require users to sign in: Sign-in controls access to the agent, not tool availability.
9dfb00fa7370.Asynchronous response: Asynchronous response is a setting on agent flows, not computer use.

475b3929b9fb.Bring-your-own machine, which requires I: Bringing your own machine requires registering it through Power Automate, which is more setup than needed for a quick trial.
475b3929b9fb.Cloud PC pool, which can't access the in: Cloud PC pools can access the web and organizational resources.
475b3929b9fb.Power Automate hosted machine group, whi: Hosted machine groups aren't the zero-setup option described for quick experimentation.

04e88c61e22a.Hosted browser: The hosted browser doesn't support custom desktop apps.
04e88c61e22a.A REST API tool: A REST API tool needs an API, which a desktop app may not expose.
04e88c61e22a.The demo website channel, which runs the: The demo website is a channel for chatting with the agent, not a place where computer use runs.

441275f3c539.Install Microsoft Teams on the machine: Teams isn't required for computer use.
441275f3c539.Add the machine to a component collectio: Component collections package agent components, not machines.
441275f3c539.Join the machine to a Fabric workspace: Fabric workspaces are unrelated to computer use machines.

8dabf2f9f418.All three run in parallel on separate de: A single machine doesn't run multiple computer use sessions in parallel.
8dabf2f9f418.The second and third runs fail immediate: Runs are queued rather than failed.
8dabf2f9f418.The runs move to the hosted browser auto: There is no automatic failover to the hosted browser.

825bdd86df6f.It blocks navigation to the news site en: The allow list doesn't prevent navigation.
825bdd86df6f.It ends the run and emails the maker: Opening the site doesn't automatically end the run.
825bdd86df6f.It has no effect on that site unless Enf: The allow list works independently of Enforce HTTPS.

3b5e9eccca58.The run pauses until the maker opens the: The maker opening the test pane isn't the supervision mechanism.
3b5e9eccca58.The agent posts the request in a Teams c: The run doesn't continue automatically past a supervision request.
3b5e9eccca58.The run retries the action three times a: There's no retry-and-proceed behavior for harmful-instruction detection.

e143024a254b.Only by reading Application Insights log: The test experience shows activity live, not only after the run.
e143024a254b.By connecting to the machine with Remote: Remote Desktop isn't required to monitor runs.
e143024a254b.By exporting the run to Power BI: Exporting to Power BI isn't how runs are monitored during testing.

9b9fabea3615.Nothing, because SSE is the default tran: SSE is no longer supported for MCP in Copilot Studio.
9b9fabea3615.Wrap it in a Fabric data agent: Fabric data agents are unrelated to MCP transport.
9b9fabea3615.Register it as an A2A agent: A2A is a different protocol for agents, not a workaround for MCP transport.

90a6928b5ae1.OAuth 2.0 Manual: Manual requires entering client ID, secret and URLs yourself, which is unnecessary here.
90a6928b5ae1.API key in a header: An API key doesn't use the server's OAuth capability.
90a6928b5ae1.OAuth 2.0 Dynamic: Dynamic is for servers that support DCR but not discovery, so you'd enter URLs manually.

61da6846505d.x-ms-visibility: important on every para: x-ms-visibility controls parameter display and doesn't mark MCP support.
61da6846505d.An OpenAPI 3.1 webhooks section: Custom connectors use Swagger 2.0, and webhooks don't mark MCP support.
61da6846505d.A securityDefinitions entry of type basi: Basic auth isn't what identifies the operation as an MCP endpoint.

510865b0762a.Tools only: Resources are also supported, not only tools.
510865b0762a.Tools, resources and prompts: Prompts aren't supported, so all three isn't correct.

30b905e4a516.Azure Policy assigned to the subscriptio: Azure Policy governs Azure resources, not which connectors makers can use in Copilot Studio.
30b905e4a516.The Official source setting: Official source applies to knowledge sources.

e4a1af355dff.The upload fails, because REST API tools: The tool requires a JSON file, not YAML.
e4a1af355dff.The tool is created as an MCP server: REST API tools aren't created as MCP servers.
e4a1af355dff.You must rewrite the spec manually in v2: Manual conversion isn't required because it's automatic.

26bbd6f6ef00.Rename it in the tool configuration, and: Parameter names can't be renamed in the tool configuration.
26bbd6f6ef00.Delete it and add a new parameter: You can exclude operations, but you can't add parameters outside the spec.

b6ada57d7535.Recreate the API as a REST API tool: Recreating the API duplicates work that the existing connector already covers.
b6ada57d7535.Add the custom connector as a real-time: Knowledge sources are for retrieval, not for running ticket operations.
b6ada57d7535.Wrap it in a Send HTTP request node: An HTTP node bypasses the connector and its governed connection.

a6fe3413ea66.Add it as a child agent: Child agents live within the main agent and share its settings and deployment.
a6fe3413ea66.Copy its topics into your agent: Copying topics breaks ownership and leaves two diverging copies.
a6fe3413ea66.Add it as a knowledge source: Agents can't be added as knowledge sources.

5a2f86dadc92.Connected Copilot Studio agents: Connected agents add separate publishing and settings that aren't needed here.
5a2f86dadc92.A2A agents hosted in Azure: A2A agents are for agents built and hosted outside Copilot Studio.
5a2f86dadc92.Separate agents linked through a Send HT: Calling agents through HTTP is unsupported for this purpose and adds complexity.

52a47f26f9c5.Switch the agent to classic orchestratio: Orchestration mode isn't the setting that controls connections.
52a47f26f9c5.Delete its description: Deleting the description hurts routing but doesn't block connections.

bc2ab13012c7.Connected agents are cached for 24 hours: There is no 24-hour cache. Publishing is what matters.
bc2ab13012c7.The main agent must be exported again: Exporting the main agent doesn't change which version of the connected agent is used.
bc2ab13012c7.Connected agents only pick up changes af: Pipelines aren't required. Publishing the connected agent is enough.

1a6635848c8a.Turn on Require users to sign in: Requiring sign-in doesn't limit what context is passed to connected agents.
1a6635848c8a.Mark the connected agent as an official: Official source is a knowledge setting.
1a6635848c8a.Use a child agent with no instructions: A child agent shares the main agent's context and doesn't solve the requirement.

991cb2be4f8b.It works only if A is in a different env: Connected Copilot Studio agents must be in the same environment, not different ones.
991cb2be4f8b.It works only if B uses classic orchestr: Orchestration mode doesn't lift this limitation.

e26d85a5f604.Descriptions update only after 30 minute: There is no timed sync of descriptions.
e26d85a5f604.The original agent must be republished t: Republishing the original agent doesn't update the local description.
e26d85a5f604.The main agent ignores descriptions for: Descriptions are what the main agent uses to decide when to call the agent.

efd03b75b2fb.Delete the tool from the agent: Deleting the tool would stop the child agent from using it too.
efd03b75b2fb.Move the tool into a component collectio: Component collections are for reuse and don't control invocation.
efd03b75b2fb.Turn off generative orchestration: Turning off generative orchestration would disable the child agent routing too.

a37d8dba65ee.It sends the child's raw output to the u: Sending raw output isn't the default behavior.
a37d8dba65ee.It sends an adaptive card summary: Sending an adaptive card is an option you must choose.
a37d8dba65ee.It ends the conversation: The conversation doesn't end when a child agent completes.

cee3734226d8.The .well-known/agent.json agent card UR: The agent card URL isn't the endpoint to call.
cee3734226d8.The partner's OpenAPI definition URL: An OpenAPI definition is for REST tools, not A2A agents.
cee3734226d8.The partner's MCP server URL: An MCP server is a different integration type.

7a3ff2f97eb9.Only the latest user message: More than the latest message is sent.
7a3ff2f97eb9.Only the variables you map: A2A doesn't send only mapped variables.
7a3ff2f97eb9.Only the agent's instructions: The agent's own instructions aren't what's sent to the external agent.

8c42d4158809.A Copilot connector: Copilot connectors index content for knowledge, not agents.
8c42d4158809.A REST API tool: A REST API tool is for plain APIs rather than agents that implement A2A.
8c42d4158809.A child agent: Child agents are built inside Copilot Studio.

9d2f9092d420.The Foundry subscription key, the deploy: A subscription key and model name identify a model, not an agent.
9d2f9092d420.The agent card URL: An agent card URL is part of A2A, not the Foundry integration.
9d2f9092d420.The Application Insights connection stri: Application Insights is for telemetry, not agent connection.

c76ea752d227.The Fabric data agent must be exported i: Fabric data agents aren't moved through Power Platform solutions to be connected.
c76ea752d227.The lakehouse must be copied into Datave: The data stays in Fabric. There's no need to copy it to Dataverse.
c76ea752d227.The agent must use No authentication: Users need access to the data agent and its sources, which requires identity.

d3819f4d80bf.They don't have the Bot Transcript Viewe: Transcript access doesn't affect data agent queries.
d3819f4d80bf.They're using the Teams channel: Teams is the formally validated channel for this scenario.
d3819f4d80bf.They haven't enabled Application Insight: Telemetry doesn't affect whether queries succeed.

9fa4a627cf03.It works the same as in Teams, because b: The behavior differs from Teams for this channel.
9fa4a627cf03.It needs an A2A wrapper: An A2A wrapper isn't the documented fix.
